goal: Six optional PHY4605 extension slides deriving a bridge-circuit 3x3 mesh-current system, patiently and exactly, for novice Year-2 physics students. Insert after existing lecture slide13.

style.name: Teaching Courseware
style.visual_direction: Match existing PHY4605 approved course deck and retained representative slide. White or very light neutral open canvas, large navy sans-serif title, clear regular body and math text, moderate density, muted blue model content, sage validation, sparse muted ochre prompts. No enclosing frame, numbering, watermark, or timing. Vary layouts by content role; derivation sequence may intentionally repeat.

deck_context.canonical_model: Nine ideal resistors R1,R2,R3,R4,R5,R6,R7,R8,Rb. Source Vs positive at top of left source. All three mesh currents CLOCKWISE. I1 left face, I2 LOWER triangular face, I3 UPPER triangular face. Mesh1 boundary R1,R4,R7,Vs; mesh2 R7,R5,R6,Rb; mesh3 R2,R3,R8,Rb. R7 shared I1/I2; Rb shared I2/I3; no I1/I3 branch. In I1 direction R7 current=I1-I2 downwards; in I2 direction R7=I2-I1 upwards, Rb=I2-I3 down-right; in I3 direction Rb=I3-I2 up-left. All resistance values symbolic.
deck_context.assessment_scope: Optional worked extension; no new ordinary-pass 3x3 assessment demand.

slides.title: Identify three meshes and two shared branches
key_points: Choose I1, I2 and I3 clockwise.
R7 is shared by meshes 1 and 2.
Rb is shared by meshes 2 and 3.

layout.intent: Large exact circuit central-left; three compact aligned mesh-boundary labels on right (I1: R1,R4,R7,Vs; I2: R7,R5,R6,Rb; I3: R2,R3,R8,Rb). Short shared-current callouts close to R7 and Rb. Avoid a three-card template. Distinguish clockwise reference mesh contributions from actual net branch currents.

required_images.fidelity: Preserve topology, source polarity, EVERY resistor label and clockwise current arrow and its mesh face; include visibly, do not replace with a similar circuit.
Preserve all exact mathematical facts, subscripts, signs, order and units. Compose professional readable math as part of the generated slide; no invented values.

constraints: 16:9 complete cohesive generated slide; all English. No outer frame, page number, duration, watermark or unrelated logo.
Do not add, delete, swap, or rename any resistor, current, source, matrix term, zero or sign.
Render subscripts and proper mathematical notation, never raw LaTeX. Resistances in ohms; currents in amperes; source terms in volts.
Small Optional extension label is permitted. Keep equations readable; wrap long equations only at clear addition signs.
